Class PoweredUpMotor

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup.PoweredUpMotor
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseMotor, DCMotor, Encoder, EncoderMotor
public final class PoweredUpMotor extends Object implements EncoderMotor
The motor on one external port of a Powered Up hub, as an EncoderMotor. Get it from RemotePoweredUpHub.getMotor(HubPort), which returns the same object for a port on every call.

Call begin() once after the hub connects, and again after a reconnect, so the hub reports the position. getTachoCount() counts from zero at resetTachoCount(), which keeps the hub's own count and only remembers an offset, since the hub has no reset command.

      public void hold()
      Holds the motor where it is, resisting being turned: a speed command of 0 that the hub's speed control holds. The message follows the protocol documentation and has not been checked systematically on a hub. Any later power command releases the hold.
